title: Write a report: a phone call
instructions: This conversation has statements, questions and commands. Turn it into a report. Then check your text with the checklist and compare it with the model answer.

source: Jonas: Hi Mila! How are you?
Mila: I'm fine, thanks. I've just come back from a football game.
Jonas: Do you like American football?
Mila: Yes, I love it! Our team won yesterday.
Jonas: What are you doing at Thanksgiving?
Mila: The Morenos are going to visit their grandparents in Texas, and I'll go with them.
Mila: Of course. And don't forget to say hello to everybody in class!
items.task: Jonas is Mila's friend from her class in Ulm. The next day, he tells his class about the phone call. Write his report in English.
items.start: Yesterday I talked to Mila on the phone. I asked her
checklist: Statements: I used *said / told me* and backshifted the tenses.
Questions: I used the question word or *if / whether* and the word order of a statement.
Commands: I used *told / asked* + person + (*not*) *to* + infinitive.
I changed the pronouns and possessive determiners (I → she, our → their, me → him / me …).
I changed the time expressions (yesterday → the day before).
I didn't use quotation marks or question marks.
items.model:
Yesterday I talked to Mila on the phone. I asked her how she was. She said that she was fine and that she had just come back from a football game. I asked her if she liked American football. She told me that she loved it and that their team had won the day before.
Then I wanted to know what she was doing at Thanksgiving. She said that the Morenos were going to visit their grandparents in Texas and that she would go with them.
I told her to send me some photos. She said she would, and she told me not to forget to say hello to everybody in class.
items.hint: Jonas is talking about himself: Mila's *you* → **I / me**, Jonas's *me* → **me**.
